title: Hearty Greek Mozzarella Fritters
description: Salty, cheese‑pull fritters that bring back Mediterranean memories, made with Greek mozzarella, herbs, and a crisp rapeseed oil edge.
instructions: Preheat the rapeseed oil in a deep‑fry pan to 175°C (350°F).
Whisk the egg with a pinch of salt and pepper in a shallow bowl.
Add the flour to the egg mixture and stir until a smooth batter forms.
Fold in the chopped mozzarella, parsley, dill, oregano, and lemon zest until well combined.
Heat the oil to 175°C and drop spoonfuls of the batter into the pan, frying 2–3 minutes on each side until golden.
Use a slotted spoon to transfer the fritters to paper towels to drain excess oil.
Sprinkle a little extra salt or herbs on top while still hot.
Serve immediately with a squeeze of fresh lemon for a bright finish.
